items.label: Submission Center
items.does: A client can list the org's submissions, create one against a programme (or use the one program intake creates), start sequence 0000 and follow-ups, place Co-Author documents as leaves, run dispatch-readiness validation and shadow review, compute cross-region gaps, move a sequence through its lifecycle, and freeze or dispatch it with a Part 11 e-signature (re-auth plus MFA). Dispatch only records the dispatch. Building the eCTD package and sending it to the agency are not done from this screen, and the Planner's 'plan' button only sends a chat message to AnA.
